title: Link run answer
description: What a gateway returns on its link to a run request it accepts, a 200, application/json, unsigned: the link's transport authenticates it. The run id echoed, the run's labels as the gateway holds them, the about.details keys the run credential decides, the policy in force for the run and its digest, the run's variables, the variables the agent sees in place of credentials and tools' secrets, the names of the variables the machine's credentials are read from, the run's image when it has a wall, the policy_applied members the gateway decides, the run's proxy secret, and the run's certificate authority when the run request's wall is true and the gateway reads inside HTTPS for the run. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

run_id.description: The run id of the request, echoed.

credential.description: Where the run's credential came from, as the gateway decides it: issuer behind a separate gateway, where an issuer gave the run its run credential; none on the local link. The session's dev.qory.run.started contains exactly this.

labels.description: The run's labels as the gateway holds them: the run credential's, through the operator's mapping, behind a separate gateway; the run request's on the local link. The session's dev.qory.run.started contains exactly these.

details.description: The about.details keys the run credential decides, those whose claims it carries, with the run credential's values. The session's dev.qory.run.started contains each with this value in about.details. Absent when the run credential decides none, and on the local link.

policy.description: The policy in force for the run: the one the gateway holds for it, narrowed by the request's narrowing when it has one. Absent when there is none, and the gateway observes everything.

digest.description: sha256 of the policy as canonical JSON, hex: the digest dev.qory.run.policy_applied reports for it.

variables.description: The variables the agent's process receives, as a run configuration contains them.

placeholders.description: The variables the agent sees in place of a credential or a tool's secret the gateway holds: the session sets each to a value that is no credential, and the run passes no value of its own for one, placeholder_conflict. Names alone, never a value. Absent means none.

reserved.description: The names of the variables the machine's credentials are read from: a walled run that passes one is refused with variable_reserved, and an unwalled run has its value left out. Absent means none.

image.description: The image the run gets, the one the policy in force selects or the machine's default, resolved against the run request's images: present when the run request's wall is true. Its reference may carry a registry's credentials in its user information: never logged or reported.

applied.description: The members of dev.qory.run.policy_applied the gateway decides for the policy in force: every member but variables and harness_hosts, each present exactly when the gateway's is. The session's dev.qory.run.policy_applied is this object with its own variables and harness_hosts added.

proxy_secret.description: The run's proxy secret: at least 128 bits from the system's random source, made by the gateway for this run. The relay opens every connection with it, and without a wall the agent's proxy URL carries it as its password. Compared in constant time, never logged, refused once its run ends, sent between machines only inside TLS. Characters a URL's password and the relay's preamble carry as they are.

run_secret.description: The run's secret: at least 128 bits from the system's random source, made by the gateway for this run and given once. The session sends it in X-Qory-Run-Secret on every reload and batch; it never reaches the agent. Compared in constant time, never logged.

certificate_authority.description: The certificate of the run's own certificate authority, PEM: present when the run request's wall is true and the gateway reads inside HTTPS for the run, for a credential it holds, a tool it starts or a path rule, the policy's or the node's, and behind a wall with a server always, since a reload may bring path rules or credentials; absent otherwise, and always when wall is false. The certificate the enclosure trusts after the image's own; never its key, which stays with the gateway.
